Vendor load review

Every active Sage vendor mapped to the SOA vendor template, with Ramp matched by the Sage vendor ID. Vendors in Ramp are created in NetSuite by the Ramp sync; the rest are loaded from Sage. Tax IDs show the last 4 digits only; bank account numbers are not shown.

From Sage From Ramp Set by rule Proposed Required, missing
Ramp

Notes

  1. Vendor count.
  2. Load plan. Agreed order: Ramp syncs its vendors to NetSuite first. Then this file loads the active Sage vendors that are not in Ramp ("Loaded from Sage"), and the vendors in both are enriched with the Sage values Ramp does not hold (Sage Vendor ID, category, expense account, 1099 flag, tax ID where Ramp has none). Ramp-created vendors carry no Sage ID, so the enrichment is matched by Ramp vendor name and Ramp Vendor ID and re-keyed to the NetSuite internal ID after the sync. Bank details are imported separately for every vendor, because Ramp does not push them.
  3. Vendor ID. Sage IDs in the V-##### format are kept. The older V##### and Ramp-created RMP_# IDs get the next numbers after : . External ID is the same as Vendor ID. After the load, NetSuite should auto-generate vendor numbers V-##### starting at . The Sage ID stays in Legacy Vendor ID and Sage Vendor ID; Ramp Vendor ID is kept as its own field.
  4. Category. Sage vendor types mapped to the template's Vendor Category list: AR reseller to AR Reseller, MinIO employee to MinIO Employee, Tax to Tax agency, the rest unchanged.
  5. Subsidiary. MinIO, Inc. for all. Vendors with INR or SGD currency are marked "Subsidiary to confirm" in Question Categories.
  6. Addresses. Address 1 is the Sage main address (label Main), else Ramp's check mailing address. Address 2 is the Sage pay-to address where different (label Remit-to, default billing).
  7. Terms. Sage terms, else Ramp net terms, mapped to the NetSuite list: Sage "15 days" becomes Net 15.
  8. Accounts. Default Expense Account from the Sage default expense account, translated through the Sage# column of COA Draft v1. Default Payables Account 20100 Accounts Payable - Trade for every vendor.
  9. Tax ID and 1099. Tax ID from Sage, else Ramp's TIN; full in the load file, last 4 digits here. 1099 Eligible is TRUE where Sage has a Form 1099 type or the vendor type is 1099 Vendor.
  10. Bank details. Not in the vendor template, so they need their own NetSuite import. Bank Details says where they are held (Sage, Ramp, or both and whether the last 4 digits agree). The masked bank columns show the details to load: Ramp's where Ramp has them (Ramp is primary, including the 5 where Sage differs), else Sage's. Routing and account numbers show the last 4 digits only; the full values are in a separate bank file that is not circulated.
  11. Duplicates. Vendors with the same name are marked "Duplicate to review". No merges yet.
